arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يسٓ
transliteration: Yaa-Seeen

translations.en.sahih: Ya, Seen.
translations.en.pickthall: Ya Sin.
translations.en.yusufali: Ya Sin.
translations.id.indonesian: Yaa siin

arabic: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
transliteration: Wal-Qur-aanil-Hakeem

translations.en.sahih: By the wise Qur'an.
translations.en.pickthall: By the wise Qur'an,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Qur'an, full of Wisdom,-
translations.id.indonesian: Demi Al Quran yang penuh hikmah,

arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
transliteration: Innaka laminal mursaleen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thou art of those sent
translations.en.yusufali: Thou art indeed one of the messengers,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kamu salah seorang dari rasul-rasul,

arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
transliteration: 'Alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: On a straight path.
translations.en.pickthall: On a straight path,
translations.en.yusufali: On a Straight Way.
translations.id.indonesian: (yang berada) diatas jalan yang lurus,

arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
transliteration: Tanzeelal 'Azeezir Raheem

translations.en.sahih: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
translations.en.pickthall: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,
translations.en.yusufali: It is a Revelation sent down by (Him), the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: (sebagai wahyu) yang diturunkan oleh Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang,

arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
transliteration: Litunzira qawmam maaa unzira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon

translations.en.sahih: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
translations.en.pickthall: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
translations.en.yusufali: In order that thou mayest admonish a people, whose fathers had received no admonition, and who therefore remain heedless (of the Signs of Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: Agar kamu memberi peringatan kepada kaum yang bapak-bapak mereka belum pernah diberi peringatan, karena itu mereka lalai.

arabic: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
translations.en.pickthall: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.
translations.en.yusufali: The Word is proved true against the greater part of them: for they do not believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya telah pasti berlaku perkataan (ketentuan Allah) terhadap kebanyakan mereka, kerena mereka tidak beriman.

arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
transliteration: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal azqaani fahum muqmahoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.
translations.en.yusufali: We have put yokes round their necks right up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up (and they cannot see).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memasang belenggu dileher mereka, lalu tangan mereka (diangkat) ke dagu, maka karena itu mereka tertengadah.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw-wa min khalfihim saddan fa aghshai naahum fahum laa yubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
translations.en.pickthall: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have put a bar in front of them and a bar behind them, and further, We have covered them up; so that they cannot see.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami adakan di hadapan mereka dinding dan di belakang mereka dinding (pula), dan Kami tutup (mata) mereka sehingga mereka tidak dapat melihat.

arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Wa sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
translations.en.pickthall: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.
translations.en.yusufali: The same is it to them whether thou admonish them or thou do not admonish them: they will not believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Sama saja bagi mereka apakah kamu memberi peringatan kepada mereka ataukah kamu tidak memberi peringatan kepada mereka, mereka tidak akan beriman.

arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
transliteration: Innamaa tunziru manit taba 'az-Zikra wa khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem

translations.en.sahih: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.
translations.en.yusufali: Thou canst but admonish such a one as follows the Message and fears the (Lord) Most Gracious, unseen: give such a one, therefore, good tidings, of Forgiveness and a Reward most generous.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kamu hanya memberi peringatan kepada orang-orang yang mau mengikuti peringatan dan yang takut kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah walaupun dia tidak melihatnya. Maka berilah mereka kabar gembira dengan ampunan dan pahala yang mulia.

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa wa naktubu maa qaddamoo wa aasaarahum; wa kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We shall give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before and that which they leave behind, and of all things have We taken account in a clear Book (of evidence).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menghidupkan orang-orang mati dan Kami menuliskan apa yang telah mereka kerjakan dan bekas-bekas yang mereka tinggalkan. Dan segala sesuatu Kami kumpulkan dalam Kitab Induk yang nyata (Lauh Mahfuzh).

arabic: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
transliteration: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; iz jaaa'ahal mursaloon

translations.en.sahih: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
translations.en.pickthall: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;
translations.en.yusufali: Set forth to them, by way of a parable, the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold!, there came messengers to it.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan buatlah bagi mereka suatu perumpamaan, yaitu penduduk suatu negeri ketika utusan-utusan datang kepada mereka.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
transliteration: Iz arsalnaaa ilaihimusnaini fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon

translations.en.sahih: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
translations.en.pickthall: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
translations.en.yusufali: When We (first) sent to them two messengers, they rejected them: But We strengthened them with a third: they said, "Truly, we have been sent on a mission to you."
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) ketika Kami mengutus kepada mereka dua orang utusan, lalu mereka mendustakan keduanya; kemudian Kami kuatkan dengan (utusan) yang ketiga, maka ketiga utusan itu berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang di utus kepadamu".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa wa maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takziboon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!
translations.en.yusufali: The (people) said: "Ye are only men like ourselves; and (Allah) Most Gracious sends no sort of revelation: ye do nothing but lie."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kamu tidak lain hanyalah manusia seperti kami dan Allah Yang Maha Pemurah tidak menurunkan sesuatupun, kamu tidak lain hanyalah pendusta belaka".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
translations.en.pickthall: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Our Lord doth know that we have been sent on a mission to you:
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Tuhan kami mengetahui bahwa sesungguhnya kami adalah orang yang diutus kepada kamu".

arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
transliteration: Wa maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
translations.en.pickthall: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
translations.en.yusufali: "And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kewajiban kami tidak lain hanyalah menyampaikan (perintah Allah) dengan jelas".

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il-lam tantahoo lanar jumannakum wa la-yamassan nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
translations.en.pickthall: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
translations.en.yusufali: The (people) said: "for us, we augur an evil omen from you: if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you. And a grievous punishment indeed will be inflicted on you by us."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Sesungguhnya kami bernasib malang karena kamu, sesungguhnya jika kamu tidak berhenti (menyeru kami), niscaya kami akan merajam kamu dan kamu pasti akan mendapat siksa yang pedih dari kami".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Your evil omens are with yourselves: (deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished? Nay, but ye are a people transgressing all bounds!"
translations.id.indonesian: Utusan-utusan itu berkata: "Kemalangan kamu adalah karena kamu sendiri. Apakah jika kamu diberi peringatan (kamu bernasib malang)? Sebenarnya kamu adalah kaum yang melampui batas".

arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
transliteration: Wa jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluny yas'aa qaala yaa qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen

translations.en.sahih: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
translations.en.pickthall: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
translations.en.yusufali: Then there came running, from the farthest part of the City, a man, saying, "O my people! Obey the messengers:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan datanglah dari ujung kota, seorang laki-laki dengan bergegas-gegas ia berkata: "Hai kaumku, ikutilah utusan-utusan itu".

arabic: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon

translations.en.sahih: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
translations.en.pickthall: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.
translations.en.yusufali: "Obey those who ask no reward of you (for themselves), and who have themselves received Guidance.
translations.id.indonesian: Ikutilah orang yang tiada minta balasan kepadamu; dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang mendapat petunjuk.

arabic: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
transliteration: Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon

translations.en.sahih: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
translations.en.pickthall: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?
translations.en.yusufali: "It would not be reasonable in me if I did not serve Him Who created me, and to Whom ye shall (all) be brought back.
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa aku tidak menyembah (Tuhan) yang telah menciptakanku dan yang hanya kepada-Nya-lah kamu (semua) akan dikembalikan?

arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
transliteration: 'A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon

translations.en.sahih: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
translations.en.pickthall: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?
translations.en.yusufali: "Shall I take (other) gods besides Him? If (Allah) Most Gracious should intend some adversity for me, of no use whatever will be their intercession for me, nor can they deliver me.
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa aku akan menyembah tuhan-tuhan selain-Nya jika (Allah) Yang Maha Pemurah menghendaki kemudharatan terhadapku, niscaya syafa'at mereka tidak memberi manfaat sedikitpun bagi diriku dan mereka tidak (pula) dapat menyelamatkanku?

arabic: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
translations.en.pickthall: Then truly I should be in error manifest.
translations.en.yusufali: "I would indeed, if I were to do so, be in manifest Error.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya aku kalau begitu pasti berada dalam kesesatan yang nyata.

arabic: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
transliteration: Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!
translations.en.yusufali: "For me, I have faith in the Lord of you (all): listen, then, to me!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya aku telah beriman kepada Tuhanmu; maka dengarkanlah (pengakuan keimanan)ku.

arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
translations.en.pickthall: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
translations.en.yusufali: It was said: "Enter thou the Garden." He said: "Ah me! Would that my People knew (what I know)!-
translations.id.indonesian: Dikatakan (kepadanya): "Masuklah ke surga". Ia berkata: "Alangkah baiknya sekiranya kamumku mengetahui.

arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
transliteration: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen

translations.en.sahih: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
translations.en.pickthall: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
translations.en.yusufali: "For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour!"
translations.id.indonesian: Apa yang menyebabkan Tuhanku memberi ampun kepadaku dan menjadikan aku termasuk orang-orang yang dimuliakan".

arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
transliteration: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen

translations.en.sahih: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
translations.en.pickthall: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.
translations.en.yusufali: And We sent not down against his People, after him, any hosts from heaven, nor was it needful for Us so to do.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kami tidak menurunkan kepada kaumnya sesudah dia (meninggal) suatu pasukanpun dari langit dan tidak layak Kami menurunkannya.

arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon

translations.en.sahih: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
translations.en.pickthall: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.
translations.en.yusufali: It was no more than a single mighty Blast, and behold! they were (like ashes) quenched and silent.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada siksaan atas mereka melainkan satu teriakan suara saja; maka tiba-tiba mereka semuanya mati.

arabic: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
transliteration: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon

translations.en.sahih: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah! Alas for (My) Servants! There comes not a messenger to them but they mock him!
translations.id.indonesian: Alangkah besarnya penyesalan terhadap hamba-hamba itu, tiada datang seorang rasulpun kepada mereka melainkan mereka selalu memperolok-olokkannya.

arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon

translations.en.sahih: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
translations.en.pickthall: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;
translations.en.yusufali: See they not how many generations before them we destroyed? Not to them will they return:
translations.id.indonesian: Tidakkah mereka mengetahui berapa banyaknya umat-umat sebelum mereka yang telah Kami binasakan, bahwasanya orang-orang (yang telah Kami binasakan) itu tiada kembali kepada mereka.

arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
transliteration: Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
translations.en.pickthall: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.
translations.en.yusufali: But each one of them all - will be brought before Us (for judgment).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan setiap mereka semuanya akan dikumpulkan lagi kepada Kami.

arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon

translations.en.sahih: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
translations.en.pickthall: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;
translations.en.yusufali: A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan suatu tanda (kekuasaan Allah yang besar) bagi mereka adalah bumi yang mati. Kami hidupkan bumi itu dan Kami keluarkan dari padanya biji-bijian, maka daripadanya mereka makan.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon

translations.en.sahih: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
translations.en.pickthall: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,
translations.en.yusufali: And We produce therein orchard with date-palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth therein:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami jadikan padanya kebun-kebun kurma dan anggur dan Kami pancarkan padanya beberapa mata air,

arabic: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
transliteration: Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon

translations.en.sahih: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
translations.en.pickthall: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
translations.en.yusufali: That they may enjoy the fruits of this (artistry): It was not their hands that made this: will they not then give thanks?
translations.id.indonesian: supaya mereka dapat makan dari buahnya, dan dari apa yang diusahakan oleh tangan mereka. Maka mengapakah mereka tidak bersyukur?

arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
translations.en.pickthall: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!
translations.en.yusufali: Glory to Allah, Who created in pairs all things that the earth produces, as well as their own (human) kind and (other) things of which they have no knowledge.
translations.id.indonesian: Maha Suci Tuhan yang telah menciptakan pasangan-pasangan semuanya, baik dari apa yang ditumbuhkan oleh bumi dan dari diri mereka maupun dari apa yang tidak mereka ketahui.

arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon

translations.en.sahih: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
translations.en.pickthall: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.
translations.en.yusufali: And a Sign for them is the Night: We withdraw therefrom the Day, and behold they are plunged in darkness;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan suatu tanda (kekuasaan Allah yang besar) bagi mereka adalah malam; Kami tanggalkan siang dari malam itu, maka dengan serta merta mereka berada dalam kegelapan.

arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
transliteration: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem

translations.en.sahih: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.en.yusufali: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
translations.id.indonesian: dan matahari berjalan ditempat peredarannya. Demikianlah ketetapan Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Mengetahui.

arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
transliteration: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem

translations.en.sahih: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
translations.en.pickthall: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
translations.en.yusufali: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan telah Kami tetapkan bagi bulan manzilah-manzilah, sehingga (setelah dia sampai ke manzilah yang terakhir) kembalilah dia sebagai bentuk tandan yang tua.

arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
transliteration: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon

translations.en.sahih: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
translations.en.pickthall: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
translations.en.yusufali: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law).
translations.id.indonesian: Tidaklah mungkin bagi matahari mendapatkan bulan dan malampun tidak dapat mendahului siang. Dan masing-masing beredar pada garis edarnya.

arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon

translations.en.sahih: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
translations.en.pickthall: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,
translations.en.yusufali: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan suatu tanda (kebesaran Allah yang besar) bagi mereka adalah bahwa Kami angkut keturunan mereka dalam bahtera yang penuh muatan.

arabic: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
transliteration: Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon

translations.en.sahih: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
translations.en.pickthall: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami ciptakan untuk mereka yang akan mereka kendarai seperti bahtera itu.

arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
transliteration: Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon

translations.en.sahih: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
translations.en.pickthall: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
translations.en.yusufali: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan jika Kami menghendaki niscaya Kami tenggelamkan mereka, maka tiadalah bagi mereka penolong dan tidak pula mereka diselamatkan.

arabic: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
transliteration: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen

translations.en.sahih: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
translations.en.pickthall: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
translations.en.yusufali: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi (Kami selamatkan mereka) karena rahmat yang besar dari Kami dan untuk memberikan kesenangan hidup sampai kepada suatu ketika.

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon

translations.en.sahih: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
translations.en.pickthall: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
translations.en.yusufali: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila dikatakan kepada mereka: "Takutlah kamu akan siksa yang dihadapanmu dan siksa yang akan datang supaya kamu mendapat rahmat", (niscaya mereka berpaling).

arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen

translations.en.sahih: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
translations.en.pickthall: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
translations.en.yusufali: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sekali-kali tiada datang kepada mereka suatu tanda dari tanda tanda kekuasaan Tuhan mereka, melainkan mereka selalu berpaling daripadanya.

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
translations.en.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
translations.en.yusufali: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila dikatakakan kepada mereka: "Nafkahkanlah sebahagian dari reski yang diberikan Allah kepadamu", maka orang-orang yang kafir itu berkata kepada orang-orang yang beriman: "Apakah kami akan memberi makan kepada orang-orang yang jika Allah menghendaki tentulah Dia akan memberinya makan, tiadalah kamu melainkan dalam kesesatan yang nyata".

arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
translations.en.yusufali: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Bilakah (terjadinya) janji ini (hari berbangkit) jika kamu adalah orang-orang yang benar?".

arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
transliteration: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon

translations.en.sahih: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
translations.en.pickthall: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
translations.en.yusufali: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak menunggu melainkan satu teriakan saja yang akan membinasakan mereka ketika mereka sedang bertengkar.

arabic: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
transliteration: Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon

translations.en.sahih: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
translations.en.pickthall: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
translations.en.yusufali: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
translations.id.indonesian: lalu mereka tidak kuasa membuat suatu wasiatpun dan tidak (pula) dapat kembali kepada keluarganya.

arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
transliteration: Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon

translations.en.sahih: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
translations.en.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
translations.en.yusufali: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ditiuplah sangkalala, maka tiba-tiba mereka keluar dengan segera dari kuburnya (menuju) kepada Tuhan mereka.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
translations.en.pickthall: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
translations.en.yusufali: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Aduhai celakalah kami! Siapakah yang membangkitkan kami dari tempat-tidur kami (kubur)?". Inilah yang dijanjikan (Tuhan) Yang Maha Pemurah dan benarlah Rasul-rasul(Nya).

arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon

translations.en.sahih: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
translations.en.pickthall: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
translations.en.yusufali: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak adalah teriakan itu selain sekali teriakan saja, maka tiba-tiba mereka semua dikumpulkan kepada Kami.

arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
translations.en.pickthall: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
translations.en.yusufali: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pada hari itu seseorang tidak akan dirugikan sedikitpun dan kamu tidak dibalasi, kecuali dengan apa yang telah kamu kerjakan.

arabic: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
transliteration: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya penghuni surga pada hari itu bersenang-senang dalam kesibukan (mereka).

arabic: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
transliteration: Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon

translations.en.sahih: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
translations.en.pickthall: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
translations.en.yusufali: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka dan isteri-isteri mereka berada dalam tempat yang teduh, bertelekan di atas dipan-dipan.

arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
transliteration: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon

translations.en.sahih: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
translations.en.pickthall: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
translations.en.yusufali: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
translations.id.indonesian: Di surga itu mereka memperoleh buah-buahan dan memperoleh apa yang mereka minta.

arabic: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem

translations.en.sahih: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
translations.en.pickthall: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
translations.en.yusufali: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
translations.id.indonesian: (Kepada mereka dikatakan): "Salam", sebagai ucapan selamat dari Tuhan Yang Maha Penyayang.

arabic: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
transliteration: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon

translations.en.sahih: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
translations.en.yusufali: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (dikatakan kepada orang-orang kafir): "Berpisahlah kamu (dari orang-orang mukmin) pada hari ini, hai orang-orang yang berbuat jahat.

arabic: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
translations.en.pickthall: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
translations.en.yusufali: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Aku telah memerintahkan kepadamu hai Bani Adam supaya kamu tidak menyembah syaitan? Sesungguhnya syaitan itu adalah musuh yang nyata bagi kamu",

arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
translations.en.pickthall: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.
translations.en.yusufali: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
translations.id.indonesian: dan hendaklah kamu menyembah-Ku. Inilah jalan yang lurus.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon

translations.en.sahih: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
translations.en.pickthall: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
translations.en.yusufali: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya syaitan itu telah menyesatkan sebahagian besar diantaramu, Maka apakah kamu tidak memikirkan?.

arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon

translations.en.sahih: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
translations.en.pickthall: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
translations.en.yusufali: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah Jahannam yang dahulu kamu diancam (dengannya).

arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
transliteration: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon

translations.en.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
translations.en.pickthall: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
translations.en.yusufali: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
translations.id.indonesian: Masuklah ke dalamnya pada hari ini disebabkan kamu dahulu mengingkarinya.

arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
transliteration: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

translations.en.sahih: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
translations.en.pickthall: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
translations.en.yusufali: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari ini Kami tutup mulut mereka; dan berkatalah kepada Kami tangan mereka dan memberi kesaksianlah kaki mereka terhadap apa yang dahulu mereka usahakan.

arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
translations.en.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
translations.en.yusufali: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan jikalau Kami menghendaki pastilah Kami hapuskan penglihatan mata mereka; lalu mereka berlomba-lomba (mencari) jalan, Maka betapakah mereka dapat melihat(nya).

arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon

translations.en.sahih: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
translations.en.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
translations.en.yusufali: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan jikalau Kami menghendaki pastilah Kami ubah mereka di tempat mereka berada; maka mereka tidak sanggup berjalan lagi dan tidak (pula) sanggup kembali.

arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
transliteration: Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon

translations.en.sahih: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
translations.en.pickthall: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
translations.en.yusufali: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan barangsiapa yang Kami panjangkan umurnya niscaya Kami kembalikan dia kepada kejadian(nya). Maka apakah mereka tidak memikirkan?

arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
translations.en.pickthall: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
translations.en.yusufali: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tidak mengajarkan syair kepadanya (Muhammad) dan bersyair itu tidaklah layak baginya. Al Quran itu tidak lain hanyalah pelajaran dan kitab yang memberi penerangan.

arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen

translations.en.sahih: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
translations.en.pickthall: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
translations.en.yusufali: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
translations.id.indonesian: supaya dia (Muhammad) memberi peringatan kepada orang-orang yang hidup (hatinya) dan supaya pastilah (ketetapan azab) terhadap orang-orang kafir.

arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
transliteration: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon

translations.en.sahih: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
translations.en.pickthall: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
translations.en.yusufali: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apakah mereka tidak melihat bahwa sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan binatang ternak untuk mereka yaitu sebahagian dari apa yang telah Kami ciptakan dengan kekuasaan Kami sendiri, lalu mereka menguasainya?

arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
transliteration: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon

translations.en.sahih: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
translations.en.pickthall: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
translations.en.yusufali: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tundukkan binatang-binatang itu untuk mereka; maka sebahagiannya menjadi tunggangan mereka dan sebahagiannya mereka makan.

arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
transliteration: Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon

translations.en.sahih: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
translations.en.pickthall: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?
translations.en.yusufali: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka memperoleh padanya manfaat-manfaat dan minuman. Maka mengapakah mereka tidak bersyukur?

arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
transliteration: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon

translations.en.sahih: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
translations.en.pickthall: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
translations.en.yusufali: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka mengambil sembahan-sembahan selain Allah, agar mereka mendapat pertolongan.

arabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
transliteration: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon

translations.en.sahih: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
translations.en.pickthall: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
translations.en.yusufali: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
translations.id.indonesian: Berhala-berhala itu tiada dapat menolong mereka; padahal berhala-berhala itu menjadi tentara yang disiapkan untuk menjaga mereka.

arabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
transliteration: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon

translations.en.sahih: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
translations.en.pickthall: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
translations.en.yusufali: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka janganlah ucapan mereka menyedihkan kamu. Sesungguhnya Kami mengetahui apa yang mereka rahasiakan dan apa yang mereka nyatakan.

arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
translations.en.pickthall: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
translations.en.yusufali: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apakah manusia tidak memperhatikan bahwa Kami menciptakannya dari setitik air (mani), maka tiba-tiba ia menjadi penantang yang nyata!

arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem

translations.en.sahih: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
translations.en.pickthall: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
translations.en.yusufali: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ia membuat perumpamaan bagi Kami; dan dia lupa kepada kejadiannya; ia berkata: "Siapakah yang dapat menghidupkan tulang belulang, yang telah hancur luluh?"

arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
translations.en.pickthall: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
translations.en.yusufali: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Ia akan dihidupkan oleh Tuhan yang menciptakannya kali yang pertama. Dan Dia Maha Mengetahui tentang segala makhluk.

arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon

translations.en.sahih: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
translations.en.pickthall: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
translations.en.yusufali: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu Tuhan yang menjadikan untukmu api dari kayu yang hijau, maka tiba-tiba kamu nyalakan (api) dari kayu itu".

arabic: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
translations.en.pickthall: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
translations.en.yusufali: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah Tuhan yang menciptakan langit dan bumi itu berkuasa menciptakan yang serupa dengan itu? Benar, Dia berkuasa. Dan Dialah Maha Pencipta lagi Maha Mengetahui.

arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
transliteration: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon

translations.en.sahih: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
translations.en.pickthall: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya keadaan-Nya apabila Dia menghendaki sesuatu hanyalah berkata kepadanya: "Jadilah!" maka terjadilah ia.

arabic: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
transliteration: Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon

translations.en.sahih: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
translations.en.yusufali: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Maha Suci (Allah) yang di tangan-Nya kekuasaaan atas segala sesuatu dan kepada-Nya-lah kamu dikembalikan.
